html:
Question 6
?

Which of the following describes the level surfaces of the function f(x,y,z)=ln⁡(x−2y+z)?

a
A family of surfaces: z=e−x+2y+r2
b
A family of surfaces: z=ex−2y+r2
c
A family of planes: x−2y+z=r2
d
A family of planes: x−2y+z=−r2
e
A family of planes: x−2y+z=0
